Definition: Integration of company registration, business licensing, tax compliance, regulatory compliance data
Comments: The G2B digital one-stop shop (government-to-business platform) design was launched December 2025 by the Ministry of ICT, targeting MSMEs. Definition: Integration of CRVS data (births, deaths, marriages) into data exchange for real-time verification and service eligibility
Comments: Prior to the X-Road procurement, Djibouti conducted a pilot on sharing and exchanging information related to childbirth. This pilot was successful but temporary. X-Road was procured to formalize this and more inter-governmental bridges. CRVS integration was the first use case for X-Road. Partially integrated in backend.

Definition: Extent to which the national digital identity system is integrated with the data exchange for identity verification and authentication
Comments: Digital ID system is an ongoing project mentioned in World Bank PAMAP support. TECH5 providing biometric and digital ID security layer for the Smart Wallet (MoU signed Sept 2025 with Visa). The World Bank project includes 'Strengthening the foundational ID system.' Under development and partially integrated with X-Road in planned architecture.

Comments: Education digitalization mentioned in the Digital Transformation Strategy. No specific documentation of education registry integration with X-Road. University of Djibouti Espace Creatif digital training launched 2019. Under planning.

Definition: Integration of health records, patient registration, immunization data, and health insurance into data exchange
Comments: Digitization of healthcare is listed as a key action in the Digital Transformation Strategy 2022 (e-health systems). PAMAP project includes health as a sector for digital services. Definition: Integration of court records, case management systems, correctional services data, legal aid information
Comments: Digitization of justice is explicitly listed as a key action in the Digital Transformation Strategy 2022 pillar on digital administration. The GovStack eCabinet use case improves inter-ministerial collaboration. Under development per strategy.

Definition: Integration with national payment systems for government-to-person (G2P), government-to-business (G2B) transactions via data exchange
Comments: National Payment Gateway is planned and under implementation as part of the integrated financial management architecture. Visa MoU signed September 2025 for a national Smart Wallet. Digital payment integration is in the X-Road planned architecture but not yet fully implemented. E-filing for taxes (2019) reduced processing times.

Definition: Integration of tax administration and revenue collection systems data into the exchange platform
Comments: E-Tax system (e-filing) implemented 2019, increased compliance 15%. New tax administration system is 'under implementation' as part of the planned integrated financial management system linked to X-Road. ASYCUDAWorld customs operational. Tax systems are standalone but integration into X-Road is planned. Under development phase.

Definition: Integration of social assistance programs, grant registries, beneficiary management systems
Comments: Social protection digitalization is mentioned in Vision 2035 and the Digital Transformation Strategy. No documented integration of social assistance registries with X-Road. World Bank CPF includes human development components but no specifics on social protection data exchange.

Definition: Whether primary laws, acts, or legal instruments exist that establish authority for cross-government data sharing and govern the data exchange system
Comments: Digital Code enacted June 30, 2025 covering electronic communications, electronic tools, e-commerce, data protection, cybersecurity/cybercrime. This is comprehensive enabling legislation. No binding law requiring ministries to connect to X-Road yet (identified as gap by World Bank). SSI 2014-2024 ICT roadmap provided strategic framework. Digital Code is now among the most advanced in Africa per Jones Day.

Definition: Whether a detailed implementation roadmap with phases, milestones, and timelines exists for data exchange development
Comments: GovStack (ITU/EstDev) developed a national Digital Government Roadmap as a guiding document. The 2022 Digital Economy and Innovation Roadmap is the implementation vehicle. PAMAP (Public Administration Modernization Project, $15M World Bank) provides project-level roadmap. GovStack use case implementations (eCabinet, eConstruction Permits) were targeted for Q4 2024 launch.

Definition: Whether a formal strategy or policy document exists specifically for government data exchange and interoperability
Comments: Digital Transformation Strategy (April 2022) developed by Ministry of Digital Economy and Innovation (MENI), structured around four pillars including 'Digital Administration (e-government).' Strategy includes: digital identity systems, interoperability platforms, zero paper policy, e-Procurement. Aligned with Vision 2035. GovStack developed national Digital Government Roadmap. SSI 2014-2024 ICT roadmap preceded this.

Definition: Is artificial intelligence integrated into the data exchange for data quality, fraud detection or predictive analytics
Comments: National AI strategy is being developed with UN support (January 2026). No AI integration in the existing X-Road data exchange platform. AI strategy is planned, not yet adopted. Djibouti's Digital Transformation Strategy (2022) mentions data-driven society but no operational AI in data exchange documented.

Definition: Extent to which the data exchange enables services accessible to all population groups including persons with disabilities, elderly, low literacy
Comments: Internet penetration 59.3% (2021). The Smart Wallet initiative specifically includes offline access via post offices and 'Maisons du Citoyen' for those without smartphones. Digital literacy gap noted. GovStack supports inclusive service design. Challenges with rural internet access noted. Some progress toward accessibility but significant gaps remain.

Chapter Details: The architecture, governance, functionality and uptake of government data exchange systems. 25 variables in 4 sections. Contains latest available data. Data collection by Perplexity from a variety of sources.
Definition: Provisions ensuring national control over government data and protecting against unauthorized foreign access
Comments: Comprehensive Digital Code enacted June 30, 2025 by National Assembly, including data protection law (156 articles) with National Commission for Protection of Personal Data (CNDP). Data transfers outside Djibouti only permitted with adequate protection equivalent. Djibouti ratified AU Malabo Convention November 2023. National data center (Tier 3) operational since 2018. X-Road architecture keeps data with source agencies. Strong provisions but CNDP needs to become fully operational.

Chapter Details: The architecture, governance, functionality and uptake of government data exchange systems. 25 variables in 4 sections. Contains latest available data. Data collection by Perplexity from a variety of sources.
Definition: Extent to which provincial/state and local governments participate in the data exchange
Comments: Djibouti is a small country (approx. 1M population) with a centralized government. High-speed internet in 15 out of 16 ministry/agency sites in the capital only. No documented sub-national government participation in the X-Road data exchange platform. Digital divide between Djibouti City and rural areas documented.

Chapter Details: The architecture, governance, functionality and uptake of government data exchange systems. 25 variables in 4 sections. Contains latest available data. Data collection by Perplexity from a variety of sources.
Definition: Whether data exchange infrastructure and services reach rural and remote areas or concentrate in urban centers
Comments: Persistent digital divide between Djibouti City and rural areas. High-speed internet only in 15 of 16 ministerial sites in the capital. Digital services primarily concentrated in urban areas. Rural infrastructure limitations documented as challenge in CSM Tech analysis. Digital Transformation Strategy acknowledges need to bridge divide.
